edits.find: • Hard Stop-Loss: An unambiguous exit threshold where all open positions are liquidated to stablecoins if the underlying asset declines past a specific support level.
edits.replace: • Hard Stop-Loss: An exit threshold that closes positions if the asset falls past a set level. In fast or illiquid markets a stop can fill well below the trigger price, so it limits rather than caps losses.
